Enable ﬁne-grained access control using the console, AWS CLI, or conﬁguration API. For steps, see
Creating and managing domains.
Fine-grained access control requires OpenSearch or Elasticsearch 6.7 or later. It also requires HTTPS
for all traﬃc to the domain, Encryption of data at rest, and node-to-node encryption. Depending
on how you conﬁgure the advanced features of ﬁne-grained access control, additional processing
of your requests may require compute and memory resources on individual data nodes. After you
enable ﬁne-grained access control, you can't disable it.
